title: Canada eTA from the UK | Electronic Travel Authorisation
description: Canada eTA for British citizens flying to Canada: who needs one, how long it lasts, and how we complete and check your application.
intro: British citizens flying to Canada need an Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA), applied for online before travel. It usually lasts up to 5 years or until your passport expires. We prepare your Canada eTA application and check every detail before it is submitted.

sections.heading: Who needs a Canada eTA?
sections.text: Visa-exempt travellers, including British citizens, need an eTA to fly to or transit through a Canadian airport. You don't need one if you arrive by land or sea. UK residents on other passports may need a visitor visa instead, depending on their nationality.

sections.heading: How the Canada eTA works
sections.text: The eTA is linked to your passport and is usually valid for up to 5 years, or until your passport expires. Most applications are approved within minutes, but some take several days, so apply before you book your flights.

sections.heading: Canada eTA help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the UK. We check the rules for your passport, prepare your application and keep you updated until it's decided.

sections.heading: Before you travel to Canada
sections.text:
Check the UK government’s [travel advice for Canada](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/canada) before you book, and again shortly before you go. It covers safety, local laws, health risks and the latest entry rules.

- Passport: most countries expect it to be valid for at least six months after you arrive, with blank pages for stamps. If yours is close to expiry, renew it first.
- Health: check the NHS fitfortravel website for Canada at least eight weeks before you travel, in case you need vaccinations or malaria tablets. Some countries ask for a yellow fever certificate if you’ve recently been somewhere with yellow fever.
- Insurance: take out travel insurance that covers medical treatment and getting you home, and check it’s valid for Canada.
- Bookings: carry copies of your return ticket and accommodation, as border officers can ask to see them.

We go through the entry requirements for your passport when we prepare your application, so you know exactly what to carry.

faqs.q: Do British citizens need a visa for Canada?
faqs.a: Not for short visits. British citizens flying to Canada need an eTA instead.

faqs.q: How long does a Canada eTA last?
faqs.a: Usually up to 5 years, or until your passport expires if sooner.

faqs.q: How long does a Canada eTA take?
faqs.a: Processing times vary with the authority and the time of year. Apply as early as you can, and don’t book non-refundable travel until your visa or authorisation is approved.
